{{Top|leg}}
The '''Planetary Guard''' was the local defense force on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draenell's Point]]. At least two units, [[Thulpin Guard]] and [[Thulpin Reserve]], participated in the defending against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] raid against [[agricultural loading platform XT-21s]] during the [[Battle of Bissillirus]].
